content.text: {"headline":"Approve P3: outage message, chat deflection, break delays and overtime for 20 general agents lifts service level to 81.2% for 12:00-14:00 at ₹6,660.","why":"The spike is driven by login_issue calls (98 vs 36.1 expected) linked to open P2 INC-20261024-1535 (login HTTP 503 after a certificate rotation), with other call reasons also running about 1.4x. With no action, service level for 12:00-14:00 is predicted at 46.0% (general 28.7%) with 12.6% abandons. P3 is the cheapest plan that reaches the 80% target and follows policy: 81.2% overall, general 79.7%, payments 83.0%, abandons down to 3.8%, and rest of day at 91.3%.","trade_offs":["P1 costs nothing but only reaches 50.8% and lowers payments slightly to 65.4%. General stays at 38.2%.","P2 costs ₹384 and reaches 57.5%. General stays at 40.6% and abandons are 9.3%.","P4 reaches 88.6% with 2.5% abandons, but costs ₹9,024 (₹2,364 more) for a margin the target doesn't need.","P3 only just clears the target. General sits at 79.7%, just under 80%, so there is little buffer if uptake is lower than expected."],"watch":"Check how many of the 20 general agents actually accept overtime before 12:30. P3 depends on it, and general is already just below 80%. Also follow INC-20261024-1535: if the fix runs past 14:00 the gap won't close as planned. If calls keep rising beyond the forecast, step up to P4's 30-agent overtime. No escalation is flagged."}
